extraction_notes: MM3Z3V6 table row gives VZ minimum 3.4 V, nominal 3.6 V, maximum 3.8 V at IZT = 5 mA and Ta = 25 degC; the schema records the nominal typical value as breakdown_voltage.
Maximum zener impedance is 90 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; maximum knee impedance is 1000 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA, both from p. 2. These impedance values have no dedicated fields in the strict schema.
The p. 3 zener, forward-voltage, and leakage plots are family-characteristic figures without a legend or unambiguous MM3Z3V6-specific trace; retained curve points are labeled with that limitation.
The p. 4 capacitance plot begins at nominal zener voltage 4 V, so it does not provide a usable MM3Z3V6 point at nominal 3.6 V; specs.capacitance is null.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time value; reverse_recovery is null.
Temperature coefficient for MM3Z3V6 is -3.5 to 0 mV/degC at IZTC = 5 mA, p. 2; this field is not represented by the strict schema.
